title: Quantum-Assisted Optimization Guided by Machine-Learned Risk Maps for Aerial Surveillance Routing
summary: Analog quantum computing with neutral atom computers is rapidly evolving into a promising way to perform combinatorial optimization tasks at scale. As technology matures, exploring real use cases leveraging such unique information processors becomes warranted; one example is logistics management where vehicles are assigned routes to perform a given task. Autonomous aerial vehicles (drones) are increasingly used for surveillance over a given territory.
